name: Fashion Photographer Studio
description: One model, one gown, one pair of earrings, one street — shot by six famous photographers from tiles: Newton, Lindbergh, Leibovitz, Testino, Roversi, von Unwerth. The same woman in the same clothes in the same place, six signatures.
markdownDescription:
## Fashion Photographer Studio

One model, one gown, one pair of earrings, one street — and six famous photographers. Each photographer tile shoots the same woman in the same gown in the same place, in that photographer's signature. Six pictures, six eyes.

1. **Model photo + Model notes** — a photo of the person in plain basics, and a written description that locks the face, the hair, the tattoos, the rings.
2. **Garment photo** — the gown as a packshot. An AI writes it down once so the embroidery never drifts.
3. **Accessory photo** — the earrings. A second product in every shot.
4. **Location photo** — a street in Rome. Every shot happens there.
5. **Six photographer tiles → six shots.** Swap a tile for any of sixty photographers and rerun that column alone.

data.text: The photo shows the person in plain basics on grey, so the template can dress her. The notes describe her in words — eyes, bob, skin, tattoos, rings, earrings — and every shot quotes them next to the photo, so the face never drifts. Swap the photo and rewrite the notes for another person.

data.title: 6 · Six photographers, Six shots

data.text: A striking woman in her late twenties to early thirties with piercing pale blue eyes and a sleek, chin-length black bob with a center part that frames her angular, high-cheekboned face. Her skin is a warm medium-tan tone with a smooth, luminous finish. She has a slim, model-lean build with long elegant fingers adorned with multiple chunky silver rings on both hands. Her most distinctive features are extensive dark floral and botanical tattoos covering both forearms and hands in dense, intricate sleeve-style patterns. She wears bold cobalt-blue resin drop earrings that complement her eye color. Her brows are dark, well-defined, and slightly arched, and her lips are full with a natural rosy-nude tone.

Garment notes
data.userInput: Describe the garment in the reference image.
data.systemPrompt: You write clothing descriptions for an image generator. Look at the reference image and describe the garment in ONE paragraph of 50–70 words, plain declarative English: garment type, colour, fabric and finish, neckline, bodice, any embroidery or beading and where it sits, skirt shape and length, slit, closure. Only what is visible. No brand names, no opinions, no bullet points, no commentary. Output only the paragraph.

data.label: Shot · Helmut Newton
data.prompt: Fashion editorial photograph {Helmut Newton || in the signature style of a great fashion photographer}. Black and white. Night on the street, lit only by one hard direct flash: deep black shadows, hard edges, glossy highlights. She stands tall and commanding, one hand on the hip, cool detached gaze straight into the lens, heels, the architecture behind her rendered as graphic geometry. The light, the colour or the black-and-white, the framing, the pose and the mood above are the photographer's and override the reference photos, which set only WHO, WHAT SHE WEARS and WHERE. The woman from the model reference photo — identical face, hair, skin, tattoos and rings: {Model notes || the woman in the model reference photo.} She now wears the exact gown from the garment reference photo, unchanged in cut, colour and embroidery: {Garment notes || the gown in the garment reference photo.} And the exact earrings from the accessory reference photo. She is in the street from the location reference photo — the same facades and cobbles — but the time of day, the light and the colour treatment are the photographer's, as described above. Photorealistic, no text, no watermark.
